name: KawaiiXO
summary: No-skip raid runs (26:12). Mentions an "orb skip" in Kuldra phase 1 and wants it made consistent. Not relevant to a 6:50 route.

insights.text: Definitely some room for improvement. Just glad to get a run down on the books that didn't catastrophically fail. I realized that Kuldra's fight was going to be a major pain in the butt if I didnt go rest midway and sadly didn't bring any tea with me to restore rest on the fly.

As I said in the video description, these runs are with NO skips, I have seen a few strats online to get a whole run down to less than 7 minutes but I personally want to push the intended experience to its minimums. Obviously cutting off 2 minutes means that there are tons more of time savers to be done. I am slowly but surely learning the best routes to get through some of the mid section so I am sure I will be chopping off even more time soon

recordings.description: Cut a couple minutes off, honestly not sure what happened with that "Green Dragon" midway through. There aren't any green drags here as far as I know so not even going to try to figure that one out lol. Anyway, one thing I have seen online is people using skips to both defeat Kuldra AND unlock all of the checkpoints way way faster. I personally am trying to see how fast it can be done without any skips so I will be avoiding using any of those for my videos in this series. However, if there is anyone wanting to see runs with those skips involved I will definitely upload a few videos on those too! There are some serious time savers that can get an entire scorched ruins run down to less than 7 minutes, BUT they are very cheezy and definitely aren't intentionally coded to work that way.

recordings.description:
Finally got back to giving this another attempt (Also peep the new wand from that failed run before!) There are obviously a GOOD amount of improvements that could be made. Considering the attempt went through with no deaths I will take it for now. Kuldra's fight actually went fairly well considering how some of the other easily skippable and *usually* rehearsed parts went. I am grateful that the first orb skip on Kuldra actually went through and I would love to get some feedback from anyone else who might know how to make that more consistent! 

Anyway, if you find yourself watching this speedrun and enjoy it, let me know! Or if you have any suggestions from the parts that were going well and where I might be able to shave time off ALSO let me know!! :D
